name: Fingertip Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a standard push-up position.
Instead of placing your palms flat, lift your palms off the ground and balance on your fingertips only.
Spread your fingers wide for better stability and weight distribution.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows, maintaining balance on your fingertips.
Descend until your chest nearly touches the ground.
Press back up to the starting position.
This variation significantly strengthens finger, hand, and forearm muscles.
Begin with modified versions on your knees if needed before progressing to full fingertip push-ups.
